sources.title: EvanRoubert/Armenian-ASR - ArmOSS
sources.snippet: A research project aiming to develop a state-of-the-art Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) model for the Armenian language. It has collected a large-scale Armenian audio dataset (hosted on Hugging Face) and is currently in the training/evaluation phase using modern self-supervised learning techniques.
